body:
If you’re a pastor or lay leader of a forward-leaning congregation in one of these cities, I hope you’ll join us for an afternoon gathering talking about how your congregation can play a role in a “great spiritual migration.”

And all are invited to an open-to-the-public conversation each evening. More information here.

(Will you forward this information to potentially interested people you know in these cities? Thanks!)
